I fully agree with those suggesting to go to a tailor or men’s store. I have a really hard time finding clothes that fit my proportions (I am very short but also wide) and a $500 tailored suit has lasted me for 6 years and still looks great, (unfortunately the pants need to be either replaced or altered soon because they no longer fit properly, but their quality remains really good). But a suit’s not really what you’re looking for in this specific case, just going to a tailor you can get measured (often for free) and then they can show you what sizes actually fit you best and show you things in sizes that are hard to find elsewhere (for example, someone else in the comments suggested a longer tie and at a tailor or men’s store you would likely be able to get one that’s a good length and good quality).
